rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (8 tracks) per http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/5_(Ed_Sheeran_album), https://www.discogs.com/release/7329735-Ed-Sheeran-5. 2011 self-released EP (via TuneCore, later Asylum), peaked at #2 iTunes UK / #46 UK Albums. 8 tracks confirmed by Wikipedia '5' box listing, Discogs '5' box set (r7329735), and the answers.com complete song list. NOTE: one AI-generated discography page (grokipedia) wrongly lists 'London Bridge (ft. Wiley & Labrinth)' as track 7 - that track does not exist on this EP and was excluded. Correct order per Wikipedia/Discogs.
